isolation.mechanism: memory scenarios use the tool-plugin lock (all tool-* except executors/pruner disabled) and isolated memoryRoot per condition; open-tool coding scenarios intentionally expose the full tool surface, so they run in a separate temporary git workspace outside this repository to keep the rubric and plugin checkout out of reach
isolation.probe: memory scenarios: one-shot headless probe listed only memory_read/save/search/update; coding scenarios: objective `node --test` exit-code and test-file hash checks

checkpoints.restore: sha256 verified per condition; mismatch makes the run invalid

dream.mode: pure consolidation (noSessions=true) for memory scenarios; dreamSessions:true scenarios run one transcript-reading consolidation and record sessionsReviewed
dream.sessionsReviewed: 0 for pure scenarios; >0 asserted for transcript-reading scenarios
